questions.question: Clarify the scope of the claims that he was Russia’s first historian of mathematics and taught its first university course on the subject; the author's wording is retained, but priority requires a historical source.

localizations.source: Clarify the scope of the claims that he was Russia’s first historian of mathematics and taught its first university course on the subject; the author's wording is retained, but priority requires a historical source.
localizations.ru: Уточнить границы утверждений «первый в России историк математики» и «первый университетский курс»: исходный авторский текст сохранён, но приоритет требует исторического источника.

questions.resolution: The priority claims are supported: the Tula State Archive guide calls Bobynin Russia’s first historian of mathematics, and Moscow University’s institutional history calls his course the first of its kind in Russia. https://guides.rusarchives.ru/node/70326 ; https://math.msu.ru/imm/history
